beats: Clicking a project tile popped open a box centered on screen, disconnected from the tile you'd just clicked.
It's like opening one drawer and having a totally different one slide out across the room.
Now, built with Radix UI, the window expands straight out of the exact tile you clicked.
Inside, the cover image stays fixed while the write-up and features scroll past it on their own.
The Projects window finally behaves the way the rest of the site always has.
